eryn.title: Hello, I am *Eryn*
story: After my daughter was born, I was a new mom. I was alone, in a city where the working language was not my own.
I looked for a fun way to bond with my baby. I found none. So I built one from what I knew: modern and contemporary dance.
Other moms came. The classes grew. Then other teachers asked me to teach them.
facts: I have taught mom and baby classes since 2006.
eryn.close: Founder and Artistic Director of MamaDances. I have served thousands of families in Montreal and its surrounding areas.
